_napomena: Preporučena mjesta i rute. Koordinate su iz OpenStreetMapa (osm = izvorni objekt). Tekstove slobodno mijenjaj; 'np' = NP Kornati, 'pp' = PP Telašćica.

places.name: Marina Kornati, Biograd
places.hr: Naš vez. Odavde kreću i ovdje završavaju svi izleti.
places.en: Our berth. Every trip starts and ends here.

places.name: INA Biograd (obala)
places.hr: Pumpa na rivi u Biogradu, najbliža vezu. Natoči prije izlaska iz luke.
places.en: Fuel dock on the Biograd waterfront, closest to the berth. Fill up before leaving the harbour.

places.name: Galešnjak
places.hr: Nenaseljeni otočić u obliku srca u Pašmanskom kanalu. Oblik se vidi iz zraka, s mora je to mali zeleni otok; obiđi ga polako.
places.en: Uninhabited heart-shaped islet in the Pašman Channel. The shape shows from the air; from the sea it is a small green island, so circle it slowly.

places.name: Prolaz Ždrelac
places.hr: Uzak kanal ispod mosta između Ugljana i Pašmana, najkraći put prema Dugom otoku. Vozi polako i drži sredinu kanala.
places.en: Narrow channel under the bridge between Ugljan and Pašman, the short way to Dugi Otok. Go slowly and keep to the middle.

places.name: Uvala Sita, Pašman
places.hr: Uvala na Pašmanu, kratka vožnja od Galešnjaka. Dobra za prvo kupanje dana.
places.en: Cove on Pašman, a short run from Galešnjak. Good for the first swim of the day.

places.name: Uvala Soline, Pašman
places.hr: Uvala na južnom dijelu Pašmana, okrenuta prema Kornatima.
places.en: Cove on southern Pašman, facing the Kornati.

places.name: Luka Tkon
places.hr: Mjesto na Pašmanu nasuprot Biogradu, s konobama uz rivu.
places.en: Village on Pašman opposite Biograd, with konobas along the quay.

places.name: Konoba Leut, Tkon
places.hr: Konoba u Tkonu, pet minuta vožnje od Biograda.
places.en: Konoba in Tkon, five minutes by boat from Biograd.

places.name: Vela Sabuša, Ugljan
places.hr: Plaža u uvali kod Kukljice, odmah iza prolaza Ždrelac.
places.en: Beach in a cove near Kukljica, just past the Ždrelac passage.

places.name: Konoba Udica, Kukljica
places.hr: Konoba u Kukljici na Ugljanu.
places.en: Konoba in Kukljica on Ugljan.

places.name: Plaža Bošana, Biograd
places.hr: Gradska plaža u Biogradu, sjeverno od marine.
places.en: Town beach in Biograd, north of the marina.

places.name: Plaža Soline, Biograd
places.hr: Duga plaža južno od Biograda, s borovom šumom iza.
places.en: Long beach south of Biograd, with pine woods behind it.

places.name: Crvena luka
places.hr: Zaštićena uvala između Biograda i Pakoštana.
places.en: Sheltered cove between Biograd and Pakoštane.

places.name: Luka Vrgada
places.hr: Uvala pred mjestom na otoku Vrgadi, mirnom otoku bez automobila.
places.en: Cove below the village on Vrgada, a quiet island without cars.

places.name: Prva Dražica, Vrgada
places.hr: Jedna od uvala na jugozapadu Vrgade.
places.en: One of the coves on the south-west of Vrgada.

places.name: Konoba Mare, Mala Proversa
places.hr: Konoba uz prolaz Mala Proversa, na putu između Kornata i Telašćice.
places.en: Konoba by the Mala Proversa passage, between the Kornati and Telašćica.

places.name: Prolaz Mala Proversa
places.hr: Plitak i uzak prolaz između Katine i Dugog otoka. Prolazi samo polako i po sredini označenog kanala.
places.en: Shallow, narrow passage between Katina and Dugi Otok. Pass slowly, in the middle of the marked channel.

places.name: Uvala Mir, Telašćica
places.hr: Uvala u Parku prirode Telašćica, pješice do slanog jezera Mir i litica prema otvorenom moru.
places.en: Cove in Telašćica Nature Park, a short walk to the Mir salt lake and the cliffs facing the open sea.

places.name: Konoba Kruševica, Telašćica
places.hr: Konoba u zaljevu Telašćica.
places.en: Konoba in Telašćica bay.

places.name: Luka Sali, Dugi otok
places.hr: Najveće mjesto na Dugom otoku, sjeverno od Telašćice.
places.en: The largest village on Dugi Otok, north of Telašćica.

places.name: Konoba kod Sipe, Sali
places.hr: Konoba u Salima.
places.en: Konoba in Sali.

places.name: Pumpa Zaglav, Dugi otok
places.hr: Najbliža pumpa za gorivo kad si u Telašćici ili Salima.
places.en: Nearest fuel dock when you are in Telašćica or Sali.

places.name: Lojena, Levrnaka
places.hr: Svijetla plaža na Levrnaki, usred Nacionalnog parka Kornati. U blizini su dvije konobe.
places.en: Pale beach on Levrnaka, in the middle of Kornati National Park. Two konobas are nearby.

places.name: Konoba Levrnaka
places.hr: Konoba na Levrnaki, nedaleko od Lojene.
places.en: Konoba on Levrnaka, near Lojena.

places.name: Luka Mana
places.hr: Uvala na otoku Mana. S druge strane otoka su strme litice prema otvorenom moru.
places.en: Cove on the island of Mana. Its far side drops in steep cliffs to the open sea.

places.name: Uvala Kravljačica, Kornat
places.hr: Uvala na otoku Kornatu, u nacionalnom parku.
places.en: Cove on the island of Kornat, inside the national park.

places.name: Vrulje, Kornat
places.hr: Najveće ljetno naselje na Kornatu, s konobama uz obalu.
places.en: The largest summer settlement on Kornat, with konobas along the shore.

places.name: Konoba Robinson, Vrulje
places.hr: Konoba u Vruljama na Kornatu.
places.en: Konoba in Vrulje on Kornat.

places.name: Uvala Lopatica, Kornat
places.hr: Uvala na Kornatu, u nacionalnom parku.
places.en: Cove on Kornat, inside the national park.

places.name: ACI Marina Piškera
places.hr: Sezonska marina u Nacionalnom parku Kornati.
places.en: Seasonal marina inside Kornati National Park.

places.name: Uvala Lavsa
places.hr: Duboka uvala na otoku Lavsi, u nacionalnom parku.
places.en: Deep cove on the island of Lavsa, inside the national park.

places.name: Ravni Žakan
places.hr: Otočić na jugu Kornata s konobom i bovama za goste.
places.en: Islet in the south of the Kornati with a konoba and mooring buoys.

places.name: Konoba Žakan
places.hr: Konoba na Ravnom Žakanu.
places.en: Konoba on Ravni Žakan.

places.name: Uvala Opat, Kornat
places.hr: Uvala na jugoistočnom rtu Kornata.
places.en: Cove at the south-east cape of Kornat.

places.name: Konoba Opat
places.hr: Konoba u uvali Opat.
places.en: Konoba in Opat cove.

places.name: Konoba Piccolo, Smokvica
places.hr: Konoba na otočiću Smokvica, na jugu Kornata.
places.en: Konoba on the islet of Smokvica, in the south of the Kornati.

places.name: ACI Marina Žut
places.hr: Sezonska marina na otoku Žutu, na pola puta do Kornata.
places.en: Seasonal marina on the island of Žut, halfway to the Kornati.

places.name: Fešta, Žut
places.hr: Restoran uz marinu Žut.
places.en: Restaurant by the Žut marina.

places.name: Uvala Statival, Žut
places.hr: Uvala na južnoj strani Žuta.
places.en: Cove on the south side of Žut.

places.name: Konoba Statival
places.hr: Konoba na Žutu.
places.en: Konoba on Žut.

places.name: Marina Hramina, Murter
places.hr: Velika marina u Murteru.
places.en: Large marina in Murter.

places.name: INA Murter
places.hr: Pumpa u Murteru, uz marinu Hramina.
places.en: Fuel dock in Murter, by the Hramina marina.

places.name: INA Jezera
places.hr: Pumpa u marini Jezera na Murteru.
places.en: Fuel dock in the Jezera marina on Murter.

places.name: Slanica, Murter
places.hr: Plaža u uvali zapadno od Murtera.
places.en: Beach in a cove west of Murter.

places.name: Uvala Kosirina, Murter
places.hr: Uvala na jugu Murtera.
places.en: Cove in the south of Murter.

places.name: Petrol, Marina Dalmacija
places.hr: Pumpa u marini Dalmacija u Sukošanu.
places.en: Fuel dock in Marina Dalmacija, Sukošan.

hr.name: Galešnjak i Pašman
hr.text: Kratka vožnja za prvi dan: otok srca, kupanje na Pašmanu i kava u Tkonu.

en.name: Galešnjak and Pašman
en.text: A short run for day one: the heart island, a swim on Pašman and coffee in Tkon.

hr.name: Crvena luka i Vrgada
hr.text: Mirna obala južno od Biograda i otok bez automobila. Dobro kad puše jače, jer ostaješ blizu luke.

en.name: Crvena Luka and Vrgada
en.text: The calm coast south of Biograd and an island without cars. A good pick on windier days, since you stay close to port.

hr.name: Ždrelac i Sabuša
hr.text: Kroz uski prolaz ispod mosta do plaže na Ugljanu.

en.name: Ždrelac and Sabuša
en.text: Through the narrow passage under the bridge to a beach on Ugljan.

hr.name: Galešnjak, Telašćica i Lojena
hr.text: Krug s naslovnice: srce, slano jezero Mir i plaža u Kornatima.

en.name: Galešnjak, Telašćica and Lojena
en.text: The loop from our homepage: the heart island, the Mir salt lake and a beach in the Kornati.

hr.name: Kornati: Levrnaka, Mana, Vrulje
hr.text: Srce nacionalnog parka: plaža, litice i ručak u Vruljama.

en.name: Kornati: Levrnaka, Mana, Vrulje
en.text: The heart of the national park: a beach, cliffs and lunch in Vrulje.

hr.name: Telašćica i Sali
hr.text: Kroz Malu Proversu u zaljev Telašćica, pa u Sali na Dugom otoku.

en.name: Telašćica and Sali
en.text: Through Mala Proversa into Telašćica bay, then to Sali on Dugi Otok.

hr.name: Jug Kornata
hr.text: Lavsa, rt Opat i ručak na Smokvici. Najduža ruta, provjeri gorivo.

en.name: Southern Kornati
en.text: Lavsa, Cape Opat and lunch on Smokvica. The longest route, so check fuel.

hr.name: Žut i sjever Kornata
hr.text: Marina Žut, uvala Statival i Kravljačica na Kornatu.

en.name: Žut and the northern Kornati
en.text: Žut marina, Statival cove and Kravljačica on Kornat.
